cases.case_label: Alu insertion in exon 4 of RP1 (Japanese founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: The known RP1 exon 4 Alu insertion introduces a frameshift and premature termination codon (p.Y1352Afs*9); screened by Sanger in 220 Japanese RP patients, found in 6 (3 homozygous, 3 heterozygous), solving 5 as AR RP (two compound heterozygotes with c.4196del or c.5797C>T).
cases.quote: We detected the Alu element insertion including a premature termination codon in the coding region (p.Y1352A fs*9) in six patients and genetically solved five
